name: baseline-then-change
description: Industrial site: 4 h baseline, then a new PLC is commissioned, a PLC gets new firmware, a contractor laptop reaches into the process cell across zones, and a PLC goes offline.

phases.name: baseline
phases.description: normal operation for the monitor to learn

phases.name: new-plc
phases.description: a ControlLogix L83E is added to the packaging line and polled by its HMI, the historian and the engineering station

phases.name: firmware-change
phases.description: PLC-PK2 (1756-L71) is flashed from 20.055 to 20.058; its List Identity / Identity object now report the new revision

phases.name: contractor-laptop
phases.description: an unmanaged contractor laptop joins the user VLAN by DHCP and talks S7 straight to a process PLC (IT -> OT-CELL)

phases.name: device-offline
phases.description: the laptop leaves; Modicon PLC-UT2 loses power - its HMI and the historian keep retrying
